title: ROUGH COUNTRY FIRED TWIST 1.91OZ CHEWING TOBACCO
description:
ROUGH COUNTRY FIRED TWIST 1.91OZ CHEWING TOBACCO

ROUGH COUNTRY FIRED TWIST 1.91OZ CHEWING TOBACCO, Twist-style means that it consists of thin tobacco fibers that are twist together into long, rope-like, strands. From these strings, you cut or bite off pieces in the size of your choice, and then chew to desire consistency and taste excretion. Rough Country Fire Twist Chewing Tobacco has a Smokey flavor character and is manufacture by the American Snuff Company. The nicotine strength is 2 on a 5-grade scale, placing it within the “normal” range compare to similar twist chewing tobacco products. Twist chewing tobacco can be experience in many different flavours and nicotine strengths. You find more variations of nicotine pouches on the Rough Country brand page.
